name: Hidden Stair (Principia Basement)
player_description: Below the sacellum floor, behind the altar base, a stone stair descends. It was not on any fort map. The stonework matches the vault entrance, not the fort construction. Whoever built the principia here knew what was below and built around it without acknowledging it in any official record.
gm_notes: SESSION 4 ESCORT ROUTE: 'Principia → Hidden stair → Sunken armory → Choking hall → Elder stair' from Handout 9. This stair is the access point for the Session 4 procession and Session 5 deep vault encounter. Discovering it in Session 1 or 2: DC 16 Investigation in the sacellum (or automatic if the party has the Handout 2 vault inscription and makes a DC 13 Religion check to connect the stonework styles). If discovered early: Corvinus's reaction when he learns the party found it is a significant beat — his fear about losing control of the timeline becomes visible. He will not thank them. He will ask how they found it and what they touched. His composure cracks slightly.
